name: Daniel Morgan Oates
alt: Portrait of Daniel Morgan Oates outdoors, smiling, in a blue jacket and tartan scarf
bio: With more than 30 years’ professional experience, Dan is a true master of his craft. With 16 RHS medals to his name, including gold at the Chelsea Flower Show, and a commitment to customer service that has earned him an excellent reputation with clients.

quote.text: I have never known anyone to be so passionate about anything like Dan is with landscaping. He’s not just a great foreman, clients love him and so do his team. Thank you for all the love and support over the years.

name: Ania Pawlowska
alt: Portrait of Ania Pawlowska wearing glasses, beside orange orchid flowers
bio: With a master’s degree in Landscape Architecture, Ania brings real depth of knowledge to every garden she designs. She joined Morgan Oates in 2013 and is now our head of garden design.

Ania is not your average garden designer. Over the years she has created some beautiful, welcoming spaces, and she has worked on several show gardens. In 2019, APL selected her design as one of the best at BBC Gardeners’ World Live.

name: Stefan
alt: Stefan the dog resting on the stone path of a finished London garden, with a bronze-glazed planter in the foreground
bio: Stefan has no plans, no tools and no opinions on planting schemes, but he keeps a close eye on the finished work. Here he is testing a new path.
